activity_summary: Standing, as you read everything, you had the book in your hands. Harrison found the leaf. In the margin, small, two words: Sweet Shakspeare. You read them, and the names above and below, and you read them again. What stood round the two words was too small to take.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the two words, and the names above and below, and the two words again.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Put the book in his hands, and kept a finger at the margin.

entities.name: John Harrison
entities.context: Found the leaf with a stubby thumb.

entities.name: Polimanteia
entities.context: Mentioned in Two words in the margin
